'''Isobe Shrine''' ({{lang|ja|石部神社}}, Isobe Jinja) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Komatsu, Ishikawa|en|Komatsu, Ishikawa|qid=Q646898|lt=Komatsu|1=Komatsu, Ishikawa}}, {{ill|Ishikawa Prefecture|en|Ishikawa Prefecture|qid=Q131281|lt=Ishikawa Prefecture|1=Ishikawa Prefecture}}, Japan. It served as the General Shrine ({{ill|Sōja shrine|en|Sōja shrine|qid=Q1107129|lt=Sōja|1=Sōja shrine}}) of {{ill|Kaga Province|en|Kaga Province|qid=Q907469|lt=Kaga Province|1=Kaga Province}}. The shrine is listed in the {{ill|Engishiki|en|Engishiki|qid=Q1342448|lt=Engishiki|1=Engishiki}} register of shrines and previously held the status of {{ill|Gōsha|ja|郷社|1=Gō-sha|qid=Q134917316}}{{efn|District Shrines|qid=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917316|qq= 近代社格制度}} under the modern shrine Ranking system.
== deity ==
The enshrined deity is Kushihikatawakeno Mikoto. However, records such as the *Kaga Province Shikinaisha Kyuuki* refer to the deity as {{ill|Ōmononushi|en|Ōmononushi|qid=Q10936701|qid=Q10936701|lt=Ōmononushi|1=Ōmononushi}}, and during the early modern period, the shrine was known as "Funamiyamaō Myōjin."
== History ==
The founding date of Isobe Shrine is unknown. It is believed to have existed prior to the separation of Kaga Province from {{ill|Echizen Province|en|Echizen Province|qid=Q1047144|lt=Echizen Province|1=Echizen Province}} in {{nihongo|823|弘仁14}}. Due to its location south of the provincial capital ({{nihongo|Kokufu|国府}}), the shrine was also referred to as "Funan-sha" (府南社). However, *Shirayama no Ki* suggests that Funan-sha was established when Kaga Province was formed.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ishikawa-jinjacho.or.jp/shrine/j0664/|title=Isobe Shrine|accessdate=2020-09-25|publisher=Ishikawa Prefecture Shrine Agency}}</ref> 
The shrine is listed in the *Engishiki Jinmyōchō* as "Kaga Province, Nomigun, Isobe Shrine" (加賀国能美郡 石部神社), categorized as a minor shrine.
Isobe Shrine likely served as the General Shrine of Kaga Province and enjoyed significant influence for a time. However, its power waned following the {{nihongo|Yūsenji Incident|涌泉寺事件}} in {{nihongo|1176|安元2}}. In {{nihongo|1600|慶長5}}, {{ill|Niwa Nagashige|en|Niwa Nagashige|qid=Q909763|lt=Niwa Nagashige|1=Niwa Nagashige}} undertook renovations of the shrine buildings, and during the {{nihongo|Edo period|江戸時代}}, the shrine received protection from the {{ill|Kaga Domain|en|Kaga Domain|qid=Q903448|lt=Kaga Domain|1=Kaga Domain}} lords. There was a period when the shrine was considered the Ichinomiya of Kaga Province, leading to disputes with {{ill|Shirayama Hime Shrine|en|Shirayama Hime Shrine|qid=Q704702|lt=Shirayama Hime Shrine|1=Shirayama Hime Shrine}}.
